# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 14 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 34 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_014_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 14

**1** Jesus said to them: "If you fast, you are sinning.

**2** If you pray, you will be condemned.

**3** If you give to charity, you will damage your inner selves.

**4** When you travel into any region and the people there welcome you, eat whatever they put in front of you and heal whoever is sick.

**5** What goes into your mouth cannot make you unclean. It is what comes out of your mouth that makes you unclean."

---

**Translation Notes (PNEUMA):**
- "You are sinning" — present tense renders the ongoing condition
- "Damage your inner selves" — "spirits" rendered as the inner person
- "People there welcome you" — the hospitality scenario made vivid
- "Eat whatever they put in front of you" — no dietary restrictions; radical hospitality
- "Make you unclean" — renders "defile" in purity-law terms; precise for the context
